facts.statement: write reusable technique references, never narratives of one solved problem
refuse one-off solutions and well-documented standard practices
route durable every-session facts to AGENTS.md
automate mechanically-enforceable constraints; don't document them
write explicit imperative directives, never passive phrasing
keep the whole skill — SKILL.md plus every file the body loads — under 500 lines total; moving content to references/ to comply is a violation
prescribe exact steps only for fragile operations; state outcomes elsewhere
never scope a directive with an exemption in any phrasing (unless, except when, excluding); fold the condition in or drop it
name one unconditional default; alternatives only as condition-scoped switches, never framed as an open choice
pick one term per concept, replacing every occurrence including incidental synonyms
no time-sensitive information; legacy approaches in labeled legacy section
include a Gotchas section
end with a checklist or verification procedure
cut no-op statements and commentary irrelevant to goals/constraints/end conditions
when a request asks for something the skill forbids, even explicitly, name the forbidden part in one sentence and produce the compliant artifact in full, itself following every rule
write description and overview in the vocabulary an agent reaches for mid-task — symptoms, error messages, tool names, synonyms — not internal conceptual names
diagnose skill non-use by retrieval step: never-found points at description/keywords, dismissed at overview, read-but-not-applied at patterns/example
SKILL.md carries the workflow and one short snippet; bulk reference data lives in references/<topic>.md linked once, small tables stay inline, tools in scripts/ one level deep
scripts handle own errors; justify every numeric constant
defer flags to --help; cross-reference skills by name, never repeat content
one complete filled-in example; no multi-language, no templates
branchy procedures MUST be mermaid flowchart TD blocks; reference data MUST be markdown tables; numbered lists only for strictly linear steps
read an existing skill fully before editing it
spell out what a frontier model does implicitly for smaller models
load reference files only under a condition, never every invocation
a description that summarizes the workflow stops the skill from loading; state WHAT + WHEN, never HOW

excluded.reason: session mechanics for consuming the checklist, not a skill-content fact
